title: Playing on a Sonos speaker
summary: Moves the queue to a Sonos room on the same Wi-Fi, with no Sonos account.
description: For learning at the kitchen speaker. The app serves its stored songs on the local network and loads them into the speaker's queue.

stories.as: a learner with a Sonos speaker at home
stories.want: to play my songs on it without an account
stories.soThat: the songs fill the room while I do other things

requirements.text: Sonos rooms and groups on the same network are found automatically; a speaker can also be given by IP address.
The queue is loaded into the speaker's own queue, and the speaker handles next and repeat itself.
The speaker streams each song from the app, whole or by byte range.
While a speaker plays, the phone's lock screen, notification and volume keys control the speaker.
